name: Dudley Charles
identity_note: Guyanese painter (b. 1945, self-taught, lives in Maryland), per Stabroek News/Vanderbilt; NOTE the list file says Trinidad and Tobago but all sources say Guyana (consistent with the instruction hint). Images are captioned 'Study, Anancy Story, 1980. Dudley Charles' in a Kaieteur News reprint of a Catholic Standard review of his 1980 'Images' show. I could not download the files (site returned HTTP 429 to my client) but the URLs are taken from the page's own img/og:image tags.
